x: A pack went through the first mile in 4:29 and then 2 miles in 9:08 but before long Moses Tanui of Kenya went clear and was not to be caught.

Superb running - but those Kenyans are something else again, sprinting for the line after almost exactly one hour's running and needing TV video replays to determine the actual winner. 1, B.Masya (Ken) 60:02; 2, M.Tanui (Ken) 60.03; 3, P.Tergat (Ken) 60:42; 4, P.Evans (Bel) 61:30.
After two miles in 8:52 Moses Tanui was pushing on hard and only Masya and Evans could stay near, with Gary Staines in his first attempt at the distance just off the back.
